bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
repo="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
cd "$repo"
branch="fix/video-chat-two-topic-pinned-doorways-20261123"
git fetch --no-tags origin "$branch"
sha="$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)"
test "$sha" = "a6bbab1eb4f9601b8eb3d8865e0e5d0f78982b2b"
work="$repo/.worktrees/video-two-topic-20261124"
if ! test -e "$work"; then git worktree add --detach "$work" "$sha"; fi
test "$(git -C "$work" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$sha"
cd "$work"
docker build -q -f artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs -t gace-video-two-topic-pins:20261124 .
docker image inspect gace-video-two-topic-pins:20261124 --format '{{.Id}}' >/dev/null
cid="$(docker create gace-video-two-topic-pins:20261124)"
trap 'docker rm -f "$cid" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
mkdir -p "$repo/deploy/state/video-two-topic-20261124"
docker cp "$cid:/app/repairTwoVideoChatPinnedEntries.mjs" "$repo/deploy/state/video-two-topic-20261124/repair.mjs"
docker exec -i deploy-gaybbs-1 node --check --input-type=module - < "$repo/deploy/state/video-two-topic-20261124/repair.mjs"
echo VIDEO_TWO_TOPIC_DOCKER_BUILD_AND_SYNTAX_PASS
